summary:
**Reject/archive is justified.** Across 108 rows, both versions produce **36 useful selections and 90 saved characters**, with identical visible strips, top-eight target recall, automatic decisions, fired actions, text, and carets. Only 28 recorded candidate lists change. This fails the [frozen development requirement](/Users/isaacthoman/.t3/worktrees/pulpo/t3-ba9b60f9/apps/keyboard-ios/audits/prefix-completion-r55/PUBLIC-CONTRACT.md:9); no fresh blind author is warranted.

Material evaluator limitations:

- **P2 — Utility counting does not require successful selection.** [main.swift:66](/Users/isaacthoman/.t3/worktrees/pulpo/t3-ba9b60f9/apps/keyboard-ios/audits/prefix-completion-r55/main.swift:66) awards savings from visibility alone; [compare.py:15](/Users/isaacthoman/.t3/worktrees/pulpo/t3-ba9b60f9/apps/keyboard-ios/audits/prefix-completion-r55/compare.py:15) sums those values without requiring `fired && fullTextPass == true`. A failed action could therefore count as useful. All 36 counted selections actually fired and passed here, so this does **not** affect the rejection.
- **P2 — Preservation coverage cannot establish the full contract.** Space actions execute without a text/caret oracle ([main.swift:56](/Users/isaacthoman/.t3/worktrees/pulpo/t3-ba9b60f9/apps/keyboard-ios/audits/prefix-completion-r55/main.swift:56)). No selection exercises nonempty trailing text. Fixtures lack blocked/rejected entries, touch evidence, ordinary autocorrection-on-space cases, and completion selections testing capitalization or canonical accent equivalence. Three `api_v2` literal branches remain unavailable in both versions. These are limitations, not observed candidate regressions.

Source review found **no material correctness defect** in the archived change. The added lane preserves correction-preferred deduplication, blocking/rejection filters, completion eligibility, and existing scores. It adds at most eight language-model evaluations and 128 processed heap entries; the existing 4,000-entry default remains. Heap pushes still depend on each visited node’s children and terminals, so 128 is not a total-operation bound.

Evidence checks passed: frozen-file hashes match; baseline bindings match HEAD; applying the archived patch in memory reproduces both candidate source hashes; raw JSON, compressed evidence, checksums, and comparison bindings agree. Per-run manifests omit the evaluator, so they alone would not constitute a complete blind-protocol freeze.

During review, production files were restored; both now match baseline. [PR #782](https://github.com/IsaacThoman/pulpo/pull/782) is linked. I made no edits, builds, or fixture additions and read no build logs or old/sealed audit data.
